points.statement: A unified approach aims for high restoration quality across multiple degradation types while remaining computationally efficient.
points.quote: This unified approach addresses the challenge of achieving high restoration quality across multiple degradation types while maintaining computational efficiency.

points.statement: The framework uses a U-shaped asymmetric transformer encoder-decoder design.
points.quote: Our framework builds upon a U-shaped architecture [39, 47, 62] with an asymmetric transformer-based encoder-decoder design, as illustrated in Fig. 3.

points.statement: Decoder levels include prompt blocks that produce learnable parameters guiding the restoration process.
points.quote: In the decoder path, we incorporate prompt blocks [37] between successive levels to generate learnable parameters that guide the restoration process.

points.statement: An alternating spatial and channel attention mechanism is embedded in transformer blocks across encoder and decoder levels.
points.quote: At the core of our approach lies an alternating spatial and channel attention mechanism embedded within each transformer block across both encoder and decoder levels.
